a3648fe15e881e3c836e954774884b26e16e647a.prompt: Build a cozy personal homepage for Vibybara — a capybara who ships software by vibing while agents write the code.
a3648fe15e881e3c836e954774884b26e16e647a.plan:
- hero: name, one-liner ('i commit the vibes'), simple CSS capybara avatar
- about section with a few fun facts (hot springs, headphones, yuzu)
- projects grid: HackTube, recipe-box, pomodoro, neon-snake — each with a one-line description
- warm, soft palette; rounded corners; gentle hover states
- footer: 'built on VibeHub — no code was typed'
a3648fe15e881e3c836e954774884b26e16e647a.summary:
Done — I created `index.html`, a self-contained cozy homepage for Vibybara that works as a static preview with no dependencies.

What's on the page:

- **Hero** — "Vibybara" with the tagline "i commit the vibes," plus a capybara avatar built entirely from CSS shapes: rounded body and head, ears, snout with nostrils, orange headphones, a floating yuzu, and animated hot-spring steam. The whole thing gently bobs.
- **About** — four fun-fact cards covering hot springs, headphones, yuzu, and shipping 47 projects without typing; cards slide slightly on hover.
- **Projects grid** — HackTube, recipe-box, pomodoro, and neon-snake, each with a one-line description and a "vibed, not typed" tag. Cards lift with a soft border highlight on hover, and the grid wraps responsively.
- **Footer** — "built on VibeHub — no code was typed."

The palette is warm creams, browns, and a soft peach accent, with rounded corners throughout and gentle transitions. Opening the file in any browser gives the full experience.

79231c296b2f371b11e5f0347290b6947e47ab3f.prompt: Add a /now section (what Vibybara is up to lately) and a light/dark theme toggle that remembers the choice.
79231c296b2f371b11e5f0347290b6947e47ab3f.summary:
Done. The Vibybara homepage now has both features, all in `index.html`:

**/now section** — a new section between "about" and "projects" with a "last updated" note and five current-happenings cards (new hot spring beta, lo-fi marsh beats vol. 3, yuzu-balancing training, project #48, a very slow book). Each card has a green accent border and a status pill ("soaking", "mixing", etc.) to visually distinguish it from the about facts.

**Theme toggle** — a fixed round button in the top-right corner (🌙/☀️) that flips between light and dark:

- Dark mode is done purely with CSS variable overrides on `[data-theme="dark"]`, so the whole palette (cards, hero glows, shadows, steam, tags) retints while the capybara's fur stays cozy. The two hardcoded hero gradients and steam color were converted to variables to make that work.
- The choice is saved to `localStorage` under `vibybara-theme` and reapplied by a tiny inline script at the top of `<body>` before first paint, so there's no light-mode flash on reload.
- With no saved choice, it defaults to the visitor's `prefers-color-scheme` setting.
- The button icon and aria-label update to reflect which theme a click will switch to.

e0a59362846d0ed236a5fff2e9bf08a513d55acb.prompt: Redraw the homepage capybara avatar to actually look like Vibybara, the site's owner — match the canonical artwork's proportions, muzzle patch, headphones with the lightning bolt, and palette. Inline SVG is fine if it beats CSS shapes. Everything else unchanged.
e0a59362846d0ed236a5fff2e9bf08a513d55acb.plan:
## Reference
The canonical Vibybara artwork is at /Users/vibybara/vibehub/public/vibybara-spring.svg — READ it for the exact look and palette, but only create/edit files in the current directory. Vibybara canon: rounded light-brown capybara, darker blunt muzzle patch down the front of the face, small dark ears, serene sleepy eyes, dark over-ear headphones with a yellow lightning bolt on the earcup, soft blush; hot-spring/yuzu motifs welcome.
e0a59362846d0ed236a5fff2e9bf08a513d55acb.summary:
Done. I replaced the CSS-shape capybara with a faithful inline SVG avatar that matches the canonical `vibybara-spring.svg`:

- **Proportions & palette** — a single rounded light-brown loaf (`#d58d59`) with canon shading (`#b5693d`) and highlight (`#e0a571`), clipped to the silhouette so nothing spills.
- **Muzzle patch** — a darker blunt patch (`#b06a3f`) running down the front of the face, carrying the nostrils and mouth.
- **Small dark ears** peeking above the head, **serene sleepy eyes** drawn as gentle closed arcs, and **soft blush**.
- **Dark over-ear headphones** — black band with a grey inner stripe, layered earcups (`#1e0c0b` / `#3a3a3c` / `#2a2a2c` with the gold `#c9a24a` ring and dashed inner circle), and the **yellow lightning bolt** (`#ffd23f`, dark outline) on the right earcup — all lifted straight from the canon artwork.

Everything else — the floating yuzu, hot-spring steam, bob animation, copy, theme toggle, and layout — is untouched. The existing `aria-label` on the `.capy` container still describes the scene; the SVG is marked `aria-hidden`.
